tasks.title: Online learning versus classrooms
tasks.prompt: Some people think that online learning will eventually replace traditional classroom teaching. Others believe face-to-face education cannot be replaced. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

tasks.title: Working from home
tasks.prompt: These days, many employees are able to work from home. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

tasks.title: Fast fashion and the environment
tasks.prompt: The fashion industry is considered one of the biggest sources of pollution. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can you suggest?
